description: This file defines the HomeBrowseFragment class for an Android TV app, which displays various categories and workout items in a Leanback-based UI. It manages loading and displaying home data, handling user interactions, and presenting workout and category cards with images loaded via Glide.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays categorized rows of workouts and categories, acting as the main navigation interface for the TV app.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter responsible for creating and binding workout item cards with image and text, using Glide for image loading.

classes.name: CategoryCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter responsible for creating and binding category item cards with image and title, using Glide for image loading.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes view holders for workout or category cards, setting focus and scale behavior.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder, populating image and text fields using Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup when view holder is unbound; currently no operation.
